elicitation_input.question: Who wrote The Origin of Species in 1859?

llm_generation.text:
Charles Darwin wrote *On the Origin of Species* (its full title is *On the Origin of Species by Means of Natural Selection*), published in 1859.

The book laid out his theory of evolution through natural selection, presenting extensive evidence gathered from his observations, including his voyage on the HMS Beagle, as well as from breeding experiments and comparative anatomy. It's considered one of the most influential scientific works ever published, fundamentally changing our understanding of biology and the diversity of life on Earth.
